name: no-review
description: Use when you already know the change and the place it goes, and could describe the diff before opening the editor — the cost of being wrong about it is small. Implement (commit as post) -> PR; no review stage, the test suite is the reviewer. Not for work whose shape still needs deciding (plan-build-review) or that deserves a second reader before it ships (single-reviewer).

stages.name: in progress
stages.description: Agent implements the task, then commits as the stage's tail work

post.name: commit
post.prompt: Commit the relevant work for this task. Original task: $TASK_PROMPT. Previous implementation result: $PREV_MAIN_RESULT

stages.name: pr
stages.prompt: Create a PR for the work on branch $BRANCH.

post.name: approve
post.prompt: Approve the PR for branch $BRANCH after PR creation and signal the merge master. Previous result: $PREV_RESULT
